message.content:
I’m happy to help!  
The travel‑API doesn’t expose a single “list all airports” endpoint—our public interface focuses on operations around bookings, payments, and traveler info. However, here’s what we can do:

| Option | What it gives you |
|--------|-------------------|
| **`get_nearest_airport_by_city(location)`** | Returns the closest major airport (in IATA code) for one of the supported cities. You’ll just pass the city name (e.g., `"London"`, `"New York"`). |
| **Static reference** | Below is a quick cheat sheet of the most common international hubs that appear across our systems. These are the airports your searches will typically hit when you query for departures/arrivals. |

### Common International Hubs (IATA)

| City / Region | Airport Code | Notes |
|---------------|--------------|-------|
| London        | LHR          | Heathrow – main hub |
|               | LGW          | Gatwick – secondary |
| New York      | JFK          | John F. Kennedy |
|               | EWR          | Newark Liberty |
| Los Angeles   | LAX          | Los Angeles Intl |
| Toronto       | YYZ          | Pearson |
| Vancouver     | YVR          | Vancouver Intl |
| Sydney         | SYD          | Sydney Kingsford Smith |
| Singapore     | SIN          | Changi |
| Dubai         | DXB          | Dubai Intl |
| Frankfurt     | FRA          | Frankfurt |
| Shanghai      | PVG          | Pudong |
| Beijing       | PEK          | Capital International |
| Hong Kong     | HKG          | Hong Kong Intl |
| Mumbai        | BOM          | Chhatrapati Shivaji |
| Johannesburg  | ORY          | O.R. Tambo |
| São Paulo     | GRU          | Guarulhos |
| Mexico City   | MEX          | Benito Juárez |
| Rio de Janeiro | GIG        | Galeão |
| Madrid        | MAD          | Adolfo Suárez |
| Barcelona     | BCN          | El Prat |
| Istanbul      | IST          | Ataturk |
| ...           | …            | Many more regional airports exist within each country’s network. |

If you’re looking for a *complete* inventory—including smaller domestic airports—you could either:
1. Pull the full dataset via our internal portal (if you have admin rights), or
2. Tell me a particular country or city, and I’ll fetch the nearest airport(s) using `get_nearest_airport_by_city`.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed!
